name: The Smiths
hook: A Manchester band whose guitarist learned from Nile Rodgers and Phil Spector, and whose singer's picture of bleak urban England fed Britpop.

blurb.age13: The Smiths formed in Manchester in 1982: Morrissey sang and wrote the words, Johnny Marr played guitar and wrote the music, with Andy Rourke on bass and Mike Joyce on drums. They were on Rough Trade, an independent label, and split up in 1987. Marr's guitar parts ring and sparkle instead of chugging; he said he learned from Nile Rodgers of Chic and from the way Phil Spector made a whole band sound like one big sound. Morrissey's songs about dull, rainy English towns and loneliness were a big influence on the Britpop bands of the 1990s, like Oasis, Blur and Suede. Since 2018 Morrissey has publicly supported a far-right British political party, and many people now argue about whether that changes how they hear the Smiths.
blurb.adult: Formed in Manchester in 1982, with Morrissey and Johnny Marr as the songwriting partnership and Andy Rourke and Mike Joyce as the rhythm section, and signed to Rough Trade in 1983; they split in 1987 amid tension between the two writers. Marr's guitar influences include Nile Rodgers, Bert Jansch, James Williamson and James Honeyman-Scott, and he described wanting records to sound symphonic, the players merged into one atmosphere, an idea he took from Phil Spector. Wikipedia credits the band, and Morrissey's portrayal of and nostalgia for a bleak urban England, as a major influence on Britpop, naming Oasis, Blur and Suede; Noel Gallagher has called Marr unique and borrowed his guitars. Marr went on to Electronic with Bernard Sumner of New Order. Morrissey said in 2017 that the UKIP leadership election had been rigged against the anti-Islam activist Anne Marie Waters, endorsed her far-right party For Britain in 2018, and wore its badge on stage in New York in 2019, while saying he despised racism; adverts for his album were withdrawn from Merseyrail stations and some shops refused to stock it, and Billy Bragg said he was dragging the Smiths' legacy through the dirt.
